summary: Iteration 29 - Privacy × Points System Coherence Testing. All 29 tests passed. Key features verified: PUT /api/auth/privacy returns updated_visits/updated_activities counts (retroactive update), all leaderboard categories (points/visits/countries/rising-stars) filter by default_privacy (only public users shown), visits and activities have visibility field, new visits inherit user's default privacy setting.
critical_code_review_comments: PUT /api/auth/privacy correctly returns {updated_visits: N, updated_activities: N} showing retroactive update counts
Retroactive update sets visibility field on ALL existing visits, activities, and country_visits for the user
GET /api/leaderboard (points category) filters by default_privacy: only public users shown on global leaderboard
GET /api/leaderboard?category=visits now filters by privacy using $lookup + public_ids pre-fetch
GET /api/leaderboard?category=countries now filters by privacy using $lookup + public_ids pre-fetch
GET /api/leaderboard/rising-stars now filters by privacy (aggregates only public users' activities)
POST /api/visits correctly inherits user's default_privacy for new visits (visibility field)
Bonus activities (country_complete, continent_complete, milestone) now include visibility field matching user's default
Auto-created country_visits inherit user's privacy setting
context_for_next_testing_agent: Privacy × Points coherence iteration 29 complete. All privacy features verified working: PUT /api/auth/privacy returns retroactive update counts (updated_visits, updated_activities). Leaderboard categories (points, visits, countries, rising-stars) all filter by default_privacy on global view. Visits and activities have visibility field. New visits inherit user's default privacy. Test user privacy reset to 'public' at end of tests. Existing endpoints verified still working: /api/feed, /api/visits, /api/community-feed, /api/landmarks?country_id=france, /api/users/{id}/profile.

PUT /api/auth/privacy.notes: Updates all existing visits, activities, and country_visits with new visibility

GET /api/leaderboard (points).privacy_filter: Filters by default_privacy: public only on global view

GET /api/leaderboard?category=visits.privacy_filter: Pre-fetches public user IDs, filters aggregation by public_ids

GET /api/leaderboard/rising-stars.privacy_filter: Filters activities aggregation by public user IDs
